name: Bias & Framing Lens
summary: Measure narrative slant without excluding ideological diversity.
instructions: Score each declarative statement on a 0-5 agreement scale (0=Strongly Disagree, 5=Strongly Agree) using direct evidence from the article.
system_prompt: You are a narrative analyst. Score each statement exactly as written based on textual evidence.
user_prompt: Evaluate this article using the bias & framing lens rubric.

questions.question: The article presents multiple relevant perspectives on contested issues.
The article uses loaded or partisan wording.
The article applies evaluative labels to actors such as corrupt, heroic, or traitorous.
